5.0.SP2.description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

values.1: Less than underlying price is in-the-money (ITM)
values.2: Less than or equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)
values.3: Equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)
values.4: Greater than or equal to underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)
